# The Salt Orchard

## Beginning

- Ilka inherits the orchard
  - The will names Marrow, not her brother
  - Aunt Bea refuses to sign
- The first frost
  - Noël arrives with the wrong keys

## Middle

- The trees bear salt instead of fruit
  - Nobody in Marrow will say why
- Ilka finds the ledger

## Ending

- The orchard is sold
